meta.defaultTitle: Master Boat Charter — Premium Eco Boat Experiences in Seychelles
meta.defaultDescription: Private boat excursions, big game fishing, transfers and rentals across La Digue, Praslin and the Inner Islands of Seychelles. Local captain, eco-conscious experiences, limited daily reservations.

hero.title: Discover Seychelles
hero.subtitle: Private, eco-conscious boat experiences designed to create unforgettable memories on the most pristine waters of the Indian Ocean.

activities.sectionLead: Four signature ways to experience the Seychelles archipelago — from castaway islands to deep-blue fishing grounds.

excursions.title: Boat Excursions
excursions.shortDescription: Explore the most beautiful islands of Seychelles — Grande Soeur, Curieuse, La Digue and beyond — while respecting local marine ecosystems.
excursions.description: Discover hidden lagoons, white-sand beaches and protected marine parks aboard a private boat with your local skipper. Each itinerary is designed to minimise our footprint while maximising what you see, taste and remember.

fishing.title: Big Game Fishing
fishing.shortDescription: Experience big game fishing in Seychelles with our experienced local captain using respectful, sustainable marine practices.
fishing.description: Head out to the deep with skippers who know the seasons, the currents and the right way to do this — tag-and-release first, light tackle when possible, no shortcut to a trophy. Snacks and drinks included.

transfers.title: Private Boat Transfers
transfers.tagline: Island to island, on your schedule
transfers.shortDescription: Travel comfortably between Praslin, La Digue and Mahé with private boat transfers tailored to your itinerary.
transfers.description: Skip the queues and the schedules. Move between the inner islands on your own time, with luggage handled, water onboard and the kind of comfort the public ferry doesn't pretend to offer.

rental.title: Private Boat Rental
rental.tagline: The boat is yours for the day
rental.shortDescription: Enjoy a fully private boat experience with skipper included — design your day, your route, your stops.
rental.description: Up to ten guests, one boat, one local captain, and a coastline to write your own day around. Tell us what matters most — long swims, quiet anchorages, a barbecue ashore — and we shape it from there.

commitments.title: A different kind of day at sea
commitments.lead: We run one boat. That's a deliberate choice — it keeps the experience personal, the impact light and the standards high.

eco.title: Respect for marine ecosystems
eco.description: No anchoring on coral, briefings before every snorkel, zero single-use plastics onboard.

captains.title: Local experienced captain
captains.description: A Seychellois skipper who grew up on these waters and reads them like a second language.

comfort.title: Comfortable boat experience
comfort.description: Toilets onboard, drinks included, shade where you need it. Premium without the show.

limited.title: Limited daily reservations
limited.description: One boat, one group at a time. You are the day, not a slot on a schedule.

block1.title: Water so clear it disappears
block1.body: Granite islands rising out of glass-flat lagoons. Schools of fish you can count from the surface. Beaches with no footprints but your own. The Seychelles aren't a backdrop — they're the entire point.

block2.title: Local first, every time
block2.body: Our captain is from these islands. The fish he shows you, the spots he chooses, the way he reads the weather — none of it comes from a guidebook. This is what an insider day actually looks like.

block3.title: Quietly, carefully done
block3.body: We keep groups small, our gear in good order and our impact minimal. No loudspeakers, no flotillas, no shortcuts. Just a good boat, a great captain and the Indian Ocean.

booking.title: Reserve your day
booking.lead: Pick a date, choose a time slot and tell us about your group. We'll confirm by email and WhatsApp within a few hours.
booking.commentsPlaceholder: Tell us anything that helps — children onboard, dietary preferences, special occasions…
booking.agreeTerms: I understand that the boat is unique and that my time slot is reserved exclusively for me once confirmed.
booking.successBody: Thank you. We've received your request and will confirm by email and WhatsApp shortly. The selected slot is held pending confirmation.
booking.errorBody: We couldn't send your request. Please try again or reach us directly on WhatsApp.
booking.policyBody: Master Boat Charter operates a single boat. Whenever a slot is booked, all overlapping options become unavailable across every activity. That's how we protect the quality of every day at sea.

items.a: We're based in La Digue and operate across La Digue, Praslin, Mahé, Curieuse, Cousin, Coco Island, Grande Soeur, Petite Soeur, Félicité, St Pierre and more.

items.q: Why is there only one boat?
items.a: It's a choice. One boat means we can keep groups small, the experience personal and our impact on the marine environment low. Every guest gets our full attention.
Drinks are included on every trip. Full-day excursions include a barbecue ashore. Fishing trips include snacks. Specific menus can be tailored.
No. Marine park fees (for sites such as Curieuse, Saint Pierre, Coco) are paid locally and not included in the rate.
Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure. Inside 72 hours, the slot remains reserved for you and rescheduling is offered subject to availability.

items.q: Is the boat suitable for children?
items.a: Absolutely. The boat is family-friendly with shade, toilets onboard and flotation gear in every size. Tell us your group composition and we'll prepare accordingly.
Inside the Seychelles inner islands the sea is generally calm and protected. For game fishing the swell is larger — we'll advise based on the day's conditions.
Booking online is reservation only — no card needed at this stage. We'll confirm by email and WhatsApp and arrange payment by bank transfer or cash on the day.

footer.tagline: Premium eco boat experiences across the Seychelles archipelago.

longDescription.title: Why choose Master Boat Charter?
longDescription.intro: Master Boat Charter is the reference for boat excursions and rentals in Seychelles. From our base in La Digue we run unforgettable days in the most beautiful lagoons of the archipelago.
longDescription.block1: Our captain is Seychellois and passionate about his island. He knows the secret spots: wild coves, deserted islets, untouched reefs. Far more than a ride, a true authentic experience.
longDescription.block2: Whether you want a private boat with skipper, a snorkeling outing, a sunset cruise, or a quick island transfer, our fleet adapts to your wishes. Every boat is regularly inspected for safety and comfort.
longDescription.block3: We are committed to sustainable tourism in Seychelles. Our excursions are designed to minimise environmental impact: no anchoring on coral, low-waste practices, marine wildlife awareness.
longDescription.block4: Pick your date, pick your activity and book directly online. Our smart calendar prevents double bookings, and confirmation is handled personally by our team.
longDescription.block5: Want a picnic on a deserted beach? A swim stop in a turquoise lagoon? A guided visit to Curieuse, Saint-Pierre or Félicité? Every outing is shaped around your wishes for unforgettable memories.
longDescription.outro: Book your excursion now and explore the marine treasures of the Seychelles with Master Boat Charter — your partner at sea.

about.title: A single boat. A whole archipelago.
about.lead: Master Boat Charter is a small, local operation built on a simple idea: do less, do it well, and leave the sea exactly as you found it.
about.story: We started with one boat, a deep love for these waters, and a frustration with how mass tourism was handling them. Years later, the boat is the same. So is the approach. What's grown is the trust — from guests who come back, and from local guides and captains who choose to work with us.

values.title: Local first
values.description: Seychellois captain, Seychellois suppliers, Seychellois rhythm.

values.title: Light footprint
values.description: No anchoring on coral, no single-use plastics, briefings on every reef.

values.title: One group at a time
values.description: We never share the boat between groups. Your day is yours.

values.title: Honest pricing
values.description: What you see is what you pay. Marine park fees stated, no hidden extras.

contact.lead: Tell us a little about your trip and we'll come back to you with a tailored proposal within a few hours.
